entries.name: Low-Volume English Reading
entries.text: From Take heed → Lord gives you; use low volume.
entries.notes: Migrated from SH-FE-C028 Leader Notes.

entries.name: English Reading with Hebrew Refrain
entries.text: Read in English; Hebrew refrain follows.
entries.notes: Reusable Achot Ketanah instruction.

entries.name: Repeat Hebrew Refrain
entries.text: Repeat after each English middle stanza.
entries.notes: Achot Ketanah refrain instruction.

entries.name: Israel Prayer Sequence
entries.text: Immediately after candle lighting and before the regular Friday evening service.
entries.notes: CTI local practice for Prayer for the State of Israel.

entries.name: Sing Hebrew Refrain
entries.text: Sing Hebrew refrain.
entries.notes: Reusable Achot Ketanah refrain instruction.

entries.name: Sing Final Hebrew Stanza
entries.text: Sing final stanza in Hebrew, including final line.
entries.notes: Achot Ketanah final stanza instruction.

entries.name: Hashkavot Supplement Navigation
entries.text: Leave time in the middle for Jery to recite memorial names
entries.notes: Migrated from RH-AM-C072 Leader Notes.

entries.name: Shabbat Candle Blessing
entries.text: We begin with the blessing over the Shabbat candles.
entries.notes: Friday Evening pilot; derived from Blessing unit and SOLO H/L treatment.

entries.name: English Responsive Reading
entries.text: Please join in this English responsive reading.
entries.notes: Reusable for English RESP readings.

entries.name: Hebrew Solo
entries.text: We continue in Hebrew.
entries.notes: Reusable for Hebrew SOLO units where no additional congregational action is established.

entries.name: Hebrew Responsive
entries.text: Please join responsively in Hebrew.
entries.notes: Reusable for Hebrew RESP units.

entries.name: Hebrew Unison
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew.
entries.notes: Reusable for Hebrew UNISON units.

entries.name: English Solo Reading
entries.text: Please listen to this English reading.
entries.notes: Reusable for English SOLO readings.

entries.name: Shema and VeAhavta
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for the Shema and VeAhavta.
entries.notes: Prayer-specific Friday Evening treatment.

entries.name: English Unison Reading
entries.text: Please join in this English reading.
entries.notes: Reusable for English UNISON readings.

entries.name: Amidah — Rise
entries.text: We continue with the Amidah. Please rise.
entries.notes: Prayer-specific common Jewish practice; no page number in v2.

entries.name: English Solo Prayer
entries.text: We continue with this English prayer.
entries.notes: Reusable for English SOLO prayer units.

entries.name: English Unison Prayer
entries.text: Please join in this English prayer.
entries.notes: Reusable for English UNISON prayer units.

entries.name: Hashkabot Memorial
entries.text: We pause for **Hashkabot**, our memorial prayers.
entries.notes: Friday Evening Hashkabot treatment.

entries.name: English Responsive Rogativo
entries.text: Please join in the English responsive **Rogativo**.
entries.notes: Friday Evening Rogativo treatment.

entries.name: Parashah and Announcements
entries.text: We pause for the weekly parashah and announcements.
entries.notes: Friday Evening notice treatment.

entries.name: Multilingual Sabbath Blessings
entries.text: We continue with the Sabbath blessings in Hebrew, English, and Ladino.
entries.notes: Derived from ALTERN and H/E/L fields.

entries.name: Kiddush in Hebrew
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for **Kiddush**.
entries.notes: Friday Evening Kiddush treatment.

entries.name: Achot Ketanah — Hebrew Opening
entries.text: Rabbi sings the first two stanzas in Hebrew, with the Hebrew refrain after each stanza.
entries.notes: RH-FE Achot Ketanah v2 page-level instruction; simplified for leader/congregational use.

entries.name: Achot Ketanah — English Continuation 1
entries.text: Reader continues in English, with the Hebrew refrain sung after each stanza.
entries.notes: RH-FE Achot Ketanah v2 page-level instruction for 67E.

entries.name: Achot Ketanah — English Continuation 2
entries.text: Reader continues in English, with the Hebrew refrain sung after each stanza.
entries.notes: RH-FE Achot Ketanah v2 page-level instruction for 68E.

entries.name: Achot Ketanah — Hebrew Conclusion
entries.text: Rabbi concludes with the final stanza in Hebrew.
entries.notes: RH-FE Achot Ketanah v2 page-level concluding instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Mizmor LeDavid
entries.text: Please join responsively in Hebrew for Mizmor LeDavid.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified instruction derived from RESP + H cue.

entries.name: RH-FE L'cha Dodi Opening
entries.text: Reader reads the English verses; Rabbi and congregation sing the Hebrew refrain between verses.
entries.notes: RH-FE page-level choreography; linked at opening L'cha Dodi cue.

entries.name: RH-FE L'cha Dodi Continuation
entries.text: Reader continues in English; Rabbi and congregation sing the Hebrew refrain between verses.
entries.notes: RH-FE continuation instruction for second L'cha Dodi page.

entries.name: RH-FE Boi V'Shalom
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for the final stanza of L'cha Dodi.
entries.notes: RH-FE final L'cha Dodi stanza.

entries.name: Holiday Kaddish after Achot Ketanah
entries.text: Rabbi chants the Holiday Kaddish to the melody of Achot Ketanah.
entries.notes: RH-FE tradition explicitly requested; follows Achot Ketanah.

entries.name: Barchu Response
entries.text: Please respond in Hebrew to Barchu.
entries.notes: Reusable for RH-FE opening and concluding Barchu.

entries.name: RH-FE Mi Chamocha
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for Mi Chamocha.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Hashkiveinu
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for Hashkiveinu.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Veshamru
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for Veshamru.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Vayechulu
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for Vayechulu.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Short Repetition
entries.text: Rabbi continues with the short Friday evening repetition.
entries.notes: RH-FE concise stage direction.

entries.name: RH-FE Psalm 23
entries.text: Please join in English for Psalm 23.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified English unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Memorial Kaddish
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for the memorial Kaddish.
entries.notes: RH-FE cue Kaddish Shalem for All Lost.

entries.name: RH-FE Hashkavot Sequence
entries.text: We pause for Hashkavot; memorial names are read between the two Hebrew portions.
entries.notes: Matches corrected canonical Hashkavot order.

entries.name: RH-FE Hashkavot Names
entries.text: Memorial names are read here; Rabbi then concludes Hashkavot in Hebrew.
entries.notes: Linked to names cue between Hebrew opening and conclusion.

entries.name: RH-FE Aleinu
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for Aleinu.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Yigdal
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew for Yigdal.
entries.notes: RH-FE simplified unison instruction.

entries.name: Rosh Hashanah Blessings
entries.text: We conclude with the Rosh Hashanah blessings in Hebrew, English, and Ladino.
entries.notes: RH-FE multilingual closing blessing.

entries.name: Rosh Hashanah Candle Blessing
entries.text: We begin with the blessing over the Rosh Hashanah candles.
entries.notes: RH-FE opening instruction.

entries.name: RH-FE Shema English Continuation
entries.text: Please join in English for the remaining paragraphs of the Shema.
entries.notes: RH-FE page-level instruction for English Shema continuation.

entries.notes: IGR-009 silent Amidah transition; YK-AM Musaf.

entries.name: RH-AM Torah Removal — Open Ark
entries.text: Open the Ark. Congregation rises.
entries.notes: RH-AM operational choreography; CTI practice corroborated by DSP structure.

entries.name: RH-AM Torah Removal — Prepare Scrolls
entries.text: Remove and prepare the Torah scrolls.
entries.notes: RH-AM operational choreography; linked to Take Out / Adorn Torahs.

entries.name: RH-AM Torah Procession — Out
entries.text: Begin the Torah procession.
entries.notes: RH-AM operational choreography.

entries.name: RH-AM Hagbah
entries.text: Call the person designated for Hagbah.
entries.notes: RH-AM operational choreography before V'Zot HaTorah.

entries.name: RH-AM Hashkavot — Rise
entries.text: Congregation rises for Hashkavot.
entries.notes: CTI RH-AM practice.

entries.name: RH-AM Shofar — Rise
entries.text: Congregation rises for the sounding of the shofar.
entries.notes: CTI RH-AM practice; reusable at first shofar service.

entries.name: RH-AM Torah Procession — Return
entries.text: Congregation rises. Begin the Torah procession back to the Ark.
entries.notes: RH-AM operational choreography.

entries.name: RH-AM Torah Return — Ark
entries.text: Return the Torah scrolls to the Ark, then close the Ark.
entries.notes: State-completion instruction for RH-AM Torah return.

entries.name: RH-AM Musaf Amidah — Rise
entries.text: Congregation rises for the Musaf Amidah.
entries.notes: CTI RH-AM practice at opening of Musaf Amidah.

entries.name: RH-AM Musaf Shofar — Rise
entries.text: Congregation rises for the shofar.
entries.notes: CTI RH-AM practice at Musaf shofar points; Not on Shabbat inherited from linked cues.

entries.name: RH-AM Torah Aliyot
entries.text: Call the aliyot in order; the Torah reader and each oleh use the blessings on page 204.
entries.notes: RH-AM leader-useful Torah service instruction.

entries.name: Torah and Haftarah Reading
entries.text: Reader chants the assigned Torah or Haftarah reading in Hebrew.
entries.notes: Reusable RH-AM reader instruction for Torah, Maftir, and Haftarah reading cues.

entries.name: RH-AM Bidding for Honors
entries.text: President conducts the bidding for synagogue honors before the Torah service continues.
entries.notes: RH-AM leader-facing instruction for the S&P bidding practice.

entries.name: RH-AM Ein Keloheinu
entries.text: Please join in Hebrew and Ladino for Ein Keloheinu.
entries.notes: RH-AM multilingual unison instruction.

entries.name: RH-AM Shofar Blowing
entries.text: Shofar blower sounds the prescribed sequence after the calls.
entries.notes: Reusable RH-AM instruction for shofar blowing cues.

entries.name: YK-KN Va'ani — Enter and Bow
entries.text: On entering the synagogue, bow reverently toward the Ark and recite Va'ani.
entries.notes: DSP-YK evening-prayer rubric: bow reverently toward the Ark on entering.

entries.name: YK-KN Tallit Before Twilight
entries.text: Before twilight, put on the tallit and recite its blessing.
entries.notes: DSP-YK rubric: tallit is worn and the blessing is recited if twilight has not yet set in.

entries.name: YK-KN Bidding for Honors
entries.text: Announce those designated for the Ark, Torah scrolls, and other service honors before the Torah ceremony begins.
entries.notes: DSP-YK explicitly directs announcement of designated Ark, Torah, reader-assistance, and Haftarah honors.

entries.name: YK-KN Kohanecha — Approach Ark
entries.text: As the service leaders approach the Ark, congregation stands and joins in Kohanecha.
entries.notes: DSP-YK: as Reader and Parnas proceed to the Ark, congregation stands and sings Kohanecha.

entries.name: YK-KN Gadlu — Torah Removal
entries.text: With the Ark open and Torah scrolls removed, Rabbi chants Gadlu.
entries.notes: DSP-YK: Ark doors are opened, Torah scrolls removed, then Reader chants Gadlu.

entries.name: YK-KN Torah Procession — Out
entries.text: Carry the Torah scrolls from the Ark toward the reading desk.
entries.notes: DSP-YK procession from Ark toward Tebah/readers' desk.

entries.name: YK-KN Romemu — Procession
entries.text: Congregation joins in Romemu as the Torah scrolls are carried to the reading desk.
entries.notes: DSP-YK: congregation chants Romemu as Torah scrolls are carried to the Tebah.

entries.name: YK-KN B'Yeshiva — Remain Standing
entries.text: Congregation remains standing while the President reads B'Yeshiva Shel Ma'ala.
entries.notes: DSP-YK directs the congregation to stand for the solemn B'Yeshiva declaration; local President role preserved.

entries.name: YK-KN Kol Nidrei — Three Recitations
entries.text: Kol Nidrei is intoned with profound solemnity; the formula is recited three times.
entries.notes: DSP-YK says Kol Nidrei is intoned three times with profound solemnity; Lev Shalem also marks three recitations.

entries.name: YK-KN Kol Nidrei — Complete Repetitions
entries.text: Rabbi repeats Kol Nidrei in Hebrew to complete the traditional three recitations.
entries.notes: Completes the three-recitation rubric while preserving the current YK-KN Rabbi role for the repetition cue.

entries.name: YK-KN Torah Procession — Return
entries.text: Begin the return procession with the Torah scrolls.
entries.notes: DSP-YK return-to-Ark choreography.

entries.name: YK-KN Mizmor L'David — Torah Return
entries.text: Congregation joins Mizmor L'David while the Torah scrolls are returned to the Ark.
entries.notes: DSP-YK: Psalm 29 is chanted while Torah scrolls are returned to the Ark.

entries.name: YK-KN Return Torahs — Ark Open
entries.text: Replace the Torah scrolls in the Ark and leave the Ark open for Return O Lord and Shuva.
entries.notes: DSP-YK directs that scrolls be replaced while the Ark remains open for the return prayers.

entries.name: YK-KN Barchu — Rise, Bow, Sit
entries.text: Congregation rises for Barchu, bows for the response, then is seated.
entries.notes: DSP-YK marks the response while bowing and then seated; Lev Shalem explicitly says rise, bow/respond, then sit.

entries.name: YK-KN Amidah — Stand Through Kaddish
entries.text: Congregation rises for the Amidah and remains standing through the Kaddish that follows.
entries.notes: DSP-YK rubric: silent Amidah standing facing Ark; stand until end of Kaddish following Amidah.

entries.name: YK-KN Ana B'Korenu — Responses
entries.text: Soloist chants Ana B'Korenu; congregation answers the recurring Hebrew responses.
entries.notes: DSP-YK and existing summary identify Ana B'Korenu as responsorial; current Soloist lead role preserved.

entries.name: YK-KN Five Psalm Readers
entries.text: Assign five readers, one each for Psalms 1, 2, 3, 4, and 24.
entries.notes: Derived from the canonical YK-KN five-reader cue followed by Psalms 1, 2, 3, 4, and 24.

entries.name: YK-KN Mourner's Kaddish — Read
entries.text: Rabbi reads Mourner's Kaddish in Hebrew; do not chant it.
entries.notes: CTI local practice explicitly confirmed by user; no melody assigned.

entries.name: Yom Kippur Candle Blessing
entries.text: We begin by lighting a candle in memory of the six million, then continue with the blessing over the Yom Kippur candles.
entries.notes: YK-KN opening instruction; user-confirmed CTI practice adds a memorial candle for the six million before the Yom Kippur candle blessing.

entries.name: Gather Tallit Corners for Shema
entries.text: When we get to Hasten we gather the four corners of our tallit together in preparation for the Shema
entries.notes: YK-AM Ahavat Olam; user-confirmed CTI practice at “Hasten.”
